subtitles.en: With your economic data, retail sales, initial job was claims and PPI, and the current has more, hey, Amda.
subtitles.zh: 来看经济数据，零售销售、初请失业金和PPI，还有更多内容，嘿，Amda。

subtitles.en: So it looks like upside, surprise on producer prices, John.
subtitles.zh: 看起来生产者价格超预期上行，John。

subtitles.en: At producer prices, on year 6.3, estimated 5.4, and in fact on the month 1.3 versus 0.6.
So PPI on a headline basis looking hot, remember that feeds into the Fed's preferred inflation gauge of CPE.
subtitles.zh: 整体PPI看起来偏热，记住这会传导至美联储偏好的通胀指标CPE。

subtitles.en: So that's important. Retail sales on a headline basis also be the expectations 0.8 versus 0.3.
subtitles.zh: 这很重要。整体零售销售也超预期，0.8%对0.3%。

subtitles.en: The thing to remember there though, of course, is that number is probably inflated by higher gas prices anyway.
subtitles.zh: 不过要记住，这个数字可能被更高的汽油价格推高了。

subtitles.en: So it's a stronger retail sales number, but probably reflecting what's going on at the pump.
subtitles.zh: 所以零售销售更强，但可能反映了加油站的情况。

subtitles.en: We'll need to see the control there to get a better gauge on the inflation story.
subtitles.zh: 我们需要看控制组数据，才能更好判断通胀情况。

subtitles.en: So I think at first glance, stronger than expected PPI numbers, we'll have to see the details of how to calculate CPE.
subtitles.zh: 所以乍一看，PPI强于预期，我们得看计算CPE的细节。

subtitles.en: But it all means into the idea that inflation right now remains hot.
subtitles.zh: 但这一切都意味着当前通胀仍然偏热。

subtitles.en: And of course, that's keeping pressure on the Fed. And do you take your time over a second, Luke?
subtitles.zh: 这当然给美联储带来压力。卢克，你能稍等一下吗？

subtitles.en: I'll get through to what's happening elsewhere. You mentioned the control group.
subtitles.zh: 我来看看其他地方的情况。你提到了控制组。

subtitles.en: Control group, a bit softer than expected. It came in at 0.1 on retail sales.
subtitles.zh: 控制组比预期略软。零售销售为0.1。

subtitles.en: The expectation was 0.3. PPI looks hot.
The jobs market does not look like a problem with claims at 1.99 and the estimate was 200.
subtitles.zh: 就业市场似乎没问题，申请人数为1.99，预期是200。

subtitles.en: We are always around 200K. Our job was claims week after week after week so we can park that story.
subtitles.zh: 我们总是在200K左右。每周的申请数据都是这样，所以可以搁置这个话题。

subtitles.en: Focus on what's happening with PPI. Hard than expected on PPI.
subtitles.zh: 关注PPI的情况。PPI比预期更强劲。

subtitles.en: Hotter than expected on course CPE. Raising the question about how life this meeting might be at the end of this month.
subtitles.zh: 核心PCE也比预期更热。这引发了关于本月底会议可能如何的疑问。

clip_research.source_claim: PPI on a headline basis looking hot: year-over-year 6.3% vs estimated 5.4%, month-over-month 1.3% vs 0.6%.
clip_research.public_baseline: BLS data and Chinese financial media confirm US PPI rose 6.3% YoY and 1.3% MoM in September, the largest monthly gain since March 2022 and the largest annual gain since December 2022.

data_driven_lessons.source: KC桌面-视频号动态数据明细.csv, 114 rows, July 2026 local analysis
winning_patterns: 机构/人物权威 + 具体数字/资产 + 强问题，例如 高盛王逸：4-5万亿城市更新会拖住楼市吗
大机构/名人 + 被逼/陷阱/真相/转向 等张力词，例如 野村辜朝明：日本央行被逼到墙角
具体数据 + 政策动作疑问，例如 6月PMI释放积极信号，政府会加码吗
反常识判断 + 下一步条件，例如 低估值可能是价值陷阱，需等待政策转向消费
中国相关议题更容易获得点击，但表达要落在政策、需求、信心、估值、产业升级这些正向框架
外资或海外权威给出对中国更积极的判断时，反差本身就是主标题，不要埋在摘要里
让观众产生单一强反应：居然如此、终于有人说、他说的是真的吗、原来中国优势在这里
大实话角度来自表达者身份与观点反差；言行反差角度必须有公开动作或披露支撑
涉及中国比较优势时，优先把外国企业被迫调整、海外权威改口或中国优势被低估写成冲突
avoid_patterns: 过长的新闻句，尤其是 24 字以上还塞多个从句
只有 策略/机会/影响/前瞻/市场/风险 这类泛词，没有具体对象或张力
美国宏观泛标题如果没有美联储/鲍威尔等强锚点，点击明显弱
纯描述式标题，例如 某市场短期风险与长期催化剂，缺少问题和冲突
经济危机/金融危机/崩盘/崩溃 这类过硬负面财经词
